page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg9a.64xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 256 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9T25 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system features 1152.0 GB of RAM, which provides a balanced memory-to-core allocation of 4.5 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage operations must utilize network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware. To support high-throughput data transfers, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 128 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this configuration.

The ecs.ebmg9a.64xlarge offers high resource density, allowing organizations to consolidate massive workloads onto a single dedicated host. This hardware profile is suited for highly parallelized computing tasks, large-scale enterprise application hosting, and general-purpose workloads that require substantial memory and network bandwidth but do not depend on local SSD storage or GPU acceleration.
